title: Problem: How can a court tell whether guidance binds?
shortTitle: Problem: How can a court tell whether guidance binds?
summary: The notes ask which evidence distinguishes a tentative policy from a binding norm.
notes: The General Electric notes ask what agency practice could overcome mandatory language, whether compliance by regulated people alone establishes binding effect, and whether safe harbors or rebuttable presumptions necessarily count as legislation. The examples contrast boilerplate disclaimers attached to commands with repeated caveats and genuinely open decisions. The issue requires examination of text and practice, including whether the agency will hear challenges to its position.
